# Owned media fixtures

Synthetic test patterns/tones, generated locally with installed FFmpeg8.0.1.
No recordings, private sources or external downloads. These test-only files are
not public samples and no encoder/decoder dependency is shipped with the app.

- `owned-video.mp4`: 1s testsrc2,96x64,10fps,8-bit420 libx264 High + mono48k AAC.
- `owned-audio.m4a`: 1s523.25Hz tone,mono44.1k AAC.
- `owned-audio.mp3`: 1s330Hz tone,mono44.1k libmp3lame.
- `owned-still.heic`: 96x64 green,one HEVC Main8 still generated by libx265,
  wrapped locally in self-contained ftyp/meta/pitm/iinf/iloc/iprp/mdat with one
  hvc1 primary item. No auxiliary item, source metadata or orientation override.

Generation used `-f lavfi`, `-map_metadata -1`, one encoder thread; AVC used
`-pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -movflags +faststart`, AAC `-c:a aac -ac 1`,
MP3 `-c:a libmp3lame -ac 1`. HEVC used `-frames:v 1 -c:v libx265 -pix_fmt
yuv420p -x265-params log-level=error:pools=none:frame-threads=1` and original
VPS/SPS/PPS in hvcC with length-prefixed owned samples. The committed exact bytes
are the fixture authority, not a claim of deterministic cross-version encoding.

| owned-audio.mp3 | 8585 | `27b1f8f756f61c074f0ca743ce8b9f214c3458ad30e84ce2c6560401fcda6fef` |
| owned-still.heic | 2695 | `965ad0cd97bdaa391af0350ed1717bd2647a8741288d63c6a9ec5d2b7ab2a813` |

Parser/service tests use injected native decoders only for format and failure
checks. Actual browser playback and unsupported-HEIC refusal are separate evidence;
these fixtures do not prove physical iOS, offline/PWA or general media support.
